jobs.description:
TIPSTER is looking for a Partnerships & Events Manager to shape, secure, and deliver the drops, pop-ups, and events we bring to hundreds of thousands of community members. Working closely with our leadership and operations team, you’ll build lasting relationships with hospitality partners, negotiate collaborations, and take an active role in bringing them to life.

TIPSTER is on a mission to change how people discover food and drink. Our drops are curated, limited-time offers that connect our community with exceptional food-and-beverage concepts. Alongside collaborations with names such as Gasoline Grill, Ceres, and Atelier September, we create events and pop-ups around the world, including our BAKERY RUN series.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in hospitality and sales who is as comfortable closing a sale as they are helping run an event. You’ll have a direct influence on who we work with and what our community gets to experience, with your focus shifting between sales and events throughout the year.

YOU WILL

• Identify and approach restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and other hospitality concepts for drops.

• Develop and pitch drop concepts, negotiate terms, and secure agreements with partners.

• Build and maintain long-term partner relationships, developing opportunities for repeat collaborations.

• Help develop new event and pop-up concepts and research potential venues and partners.

• Coordinate with venues, partners, and suppliers to keep plans, timelines, and practical details on track.

• Take part in the hands-on execution of events and pop-ups, from preparation and setup to on-site operations and follow-up.

All work will take place at our office in Frederiksberg.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced in sales, with 2-4 years of relevant professional experience and a background in the restaurant or food-and-beverage industry (e.g., you have a wine sales rep background or similar).

• Outgoing and confident in approaching new partners, with a strong instinct for building lasting relationships.

• Genuinely interested in restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and the people behind them.

• Commercially minded and comfortable pitching ideas, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several collaborations at different stages.

• Proactive and dependable, taking ownership of tasks and following them through to completion.

• Comfortable balancing relationship building and sales with practical, hands-on event work.

• Adaptable when priorities shift and eager to develop your skills in partnerships and events.

WHAT TIPSTER OFFERS

• A direct role in shaping how our community discovers great places around the world through drops, events, and pop-ups.

• A place on a team challenging how people discover and experience food and drink.

• Responsibility and opportunities to grow from day one.

• The opportunity to build long-term relationships with some of the world’s best restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and food-and-beverage concepts.

• A varied working day that combines commercial responsibility, creative development, and hands-on execution.

• An informal, collaborative workplace with a small, globally active team.

HOW TO APPLY

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Emma Trøst, Head of Operations, at emma@tipster.io or Julie Schacht, Event & Operations Manager, at julie@tipster.io.

If TIPSTER’s mission aligns with your ambitions, send your cover letter, CV, and any relevant supporting documents to career@tipster.io.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, but we are willing to wait for the right candidate.

jobs.occupation: Defence Business Development Lead, Space Inventor
jobs.description:
Space Inventor is looking for an experienced Defence Business Development Lead to drive business development, collaboration and sales within the defence and security market.

The Defence Business Development Lead will be responsible for identifying, developing and closing opportunities with defence customers, government organisations, procurement agencies, defence primes and strategic industry partners across Europe and internationally, with a focus on European, Nordic and Baltic regions.

The role will focus on satellite missions, constellations and space-based capabilities supporting areas such as ISR, SIGINT, Earth observation, maritime surveillance, situational awareness, secure communications and sovereign space capabilities.

This is a senior hands-on government- and customer-facing role. You will own opportunities from early market engagement and requirement shaping through RFI/RFP, proposal development, negotiation and contract award. As the business development lead, you will be supported by a cross-functional team of specialists that will help shape competitive and technically sound proposals.

A key part of the role is to engage with partners/primes and government officials before formal procurements are released. You will use your existing defence network and market understanding to identify emerging requirements, programmes and partnerships where Space Inventor's satellite capabilities can create operational value.

You do not need to be a satellite engineer, but you must have a solid understanding of the sales cycle and the ability to navigate complex sales processes. Additionally, you must be able to understand complex operational requirements and engage credibly with military, governmental, commercial and technical stakeholders.

The job is located in Aalborg or Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll report to the Mission Sales Director and work closely with both the marketing and sales teams.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead commercial negotiations covering scope, pricing, contractual conditions and programme requirements.

• Develop and grow Space Inventor's business within the European and international defence and security market, with focus on Nordics and Baltics.

• Identify and develop opportunities through an established network across Ministries of Defence, armed forces, procurement agencies, defence primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• Engage customers early to understand operational requirements, upcoming programmes and procurement plans before formal tenders are released.

• Own the commercial sales cycle from qualification through RFI/RFQ/RFP, proposal, negotiation and contract award.

• Develop strategic accounts and capture plans for priority defence programmes and customers.

• Identify and qualify local partners in the focus countries and build partnerships/consortia to address local needs and requirements.

• Monitor defence programmes, budgets, tenders, competitors and market developments to identify future opportunities.

• Maintain the defence sales pipeline, forecasts and opportunity strategies and contribute to Space Inventor's overall defence market strategy.

• Represent Space Inventor at customer meetings, exhibitions and industry events.

Qualifications

You should have strong knowledge of the defence sector, its operational environment and customer landscape, combined with a good understanding of space-based defence capabilities and their role in modern defence operations.

You do not need to be a technical space specialist, but you should be able to understand defence requirements, identify where satellite-based solutions can provide operational value and engage credibly with defence customers and Space Inventor's technical specialists.

We expect you to have:

• Significant proven experience within defence sales, business development, capture management, partnership development and complex defence solution sales.

• A successful track record of developing business with defence and governmental customers, including signed contracts and long-term strategic partnerships

• A strong and relevant existing network within the European defence industry, including relationships with defence organisations, procurement agencies, primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• A strong international outlook and preferably an established global defence network.

• Experience engaging directly with Ministries of Defence, armed forces, defence procurement organisations or other governmental stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of B2G sales and defence procurement processes.

• Ability to understand technically complex products and communicate their operational and commercial value.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Willingness to travel frequently within Europe and internationally.

• Ability to work closely with engineers and technical specialists when developing customer solutions.

Advantageous experience:

• Previous experience within space, satellites, ISR, SIGINT, electronic warfare, surveillance, secure communications, sensors, UAVs or other advanced defence technologies.

• Previous employment with a defence prime, defence technology company, military organisation, government organisation or procurement authority.

• Experience working with NATO nations or NATO organisations.

• Knowledge of European defence initiatives, funding programmes and procurement mechanisms.

• Military or governmental defence experience.

• Experience working with classified or security-sensitive programmes.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

jobs.occupation: Carbon flux and particle export along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland’s coastal ocean
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Ecoscience programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Research area and project description:

Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship within the Center for Ice-Free Arctic Research (CIFAR) and the Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University.

Rapid warming is increasing freshwater inputs to the Arctic Ocean from melting glaciers, ice sheets, and altered precipitation patterns. Additionally, sea ice cover is rapidly declining. These changes are transforming the structure and functioning of the Arctic coastal ocean. CIFAR aims to understand how the complex interplay between ice melt, terrestrial runoff, and changing ocean conditions affects Arctic coastal ecosystems and their functioning across spatial and temporal scales.

Fjord systems are a critical interface between the cryosphere, the terrestrial environment and the coastal ocean. They act as important sites of carbon transformation, burial and export, yet we still have a limited understanding of how ongoing freshening will influence these processes. Increasing terrestrial runoff delivers large quantities of particles, minerals and organic carbon to coastal waters, while simultaneously altering water-column structure, particle synamics, and marine primary production.

The overall aim of this PhD project will be to determine how carbon is transformed and transported along the land-ocean continuum in Greenland fjords, and how changes in freshwater inputs influence carbon fluxes and particle export in coastal waters.

The project will investigate interactions between terrestrial organic carbon, marine-produced carbon and mineral particles, with a particular focus on understanding which components of the carbon pool are retained, transformed or exported from the water column. Although much of the terrestrial carbon entering Greenland's coastal systems is transported in particulate form, freshwater runoff also supplies dissolved organic carbon that can be highly bioavailable and rapidly processed within coastal ecosystems. Understanding the fate of these different carbon pools is therefore essential for predicting how Greenland's coastal carbon cycle may respond to continued freshening.

The student will have the opportunity to combine field observations from Greenland with laboratory and analytical approaches to investigate the sources, composition, transformation and export of carbon and particles. The precise scientific focus will be developed together with the student and the wider CIFAR research team.

Qualifications and specific competences:

Applicants to the PhD position must hold a master’s degree and have demonstrated interest and background in biogeochemistry, for example through a bachelor’s or master’s thesis, research project, internship, or other relevant research experience.

• Skills in data analysis and programming, using R, Python, or other relevant programming languages and analytical tools.

• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary and international research environment.

• Good written and oral communication skills in English.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

• Marine or aquatic biogeochemistry

• Organic carbon analyses

• Particle dynamics, sedimentation or particle export

• Geochemical or stable-isotope approaches

• Processing and analysis of environmental or oceanographic datasets

• Fieldwork in marine, coastal or Arctic environments

We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are scientifically curious and interested in developing their own ideas within the broader aims of the project.

Place of employment and place of work:

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is C.F. Møllers Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus and Frederiksborgvej 399, 4000 Roskilde; Denmark.

Contacts:

Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• Christian Lønborg, c.lonborg@ecos.au.dk (main supervisor)

• Johnna Marchiano Holding, johnna@ecos.au.dk (co-supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply:

Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 01 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Formalities and salary range

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

• Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

• Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks

• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

• Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration

As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: Kickstart your Career with Deloitte’s Finance Consultancy Programme
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you interested in working in an exciting and challenging consulting role, where you can deploy and develop your skills and competencies within the CFO domain of companies? Do you hold a business-related Master’s degree by the summer of 2027, and are you ready to embark on a life-long learning journey in a leading global consulting firm? If yes, then we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Who we are

Joining our Finance Consultancy Programme, you will get to collaborate with experienced consultants on a wide variety of assignments and development opportunities. At Deloitte, we work with different project sizes across finance disciplines and industries, but the foundation is always the same: Our genuine passion for the CFO area and creating value together with our clients.

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte Technology & Transformation (former Consulting) consisting of more than 350 consultants in Denmark who work across all areas of the CFO function. We engage with clients to operate, advise, optimize, and transform their finance functions. Our clients range from domestic to international, from private to public, across various industries, sizes, and time horizons.

You will join a team that emphasizes collaboration, collegiality, coaching, and talent development. At Deloitte, we value diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, encouraging an inclusive and collaborative environment.

Job Description

Exciting tasks await you

As an Analyst in Deloitte Finance Transformation, you will experience that no workdays are the same. You will face a wide range of tasks, both in the form of interim-based roles and project-based assignments. Projects and tasks will vary across finance disciplines (e.g., operational finance or business finance) and industries (e.g., private or public), and within the first years of your career, you will be assigned to as many different projects and tasks as possible to expand your toolbox and build on your financial craftmanship.

Based on the specific client's needs and your interests, experiences, and competencies, typical assignments and projects could be within the scope of:

• Finance operations optimization and transformation, e.g., controlling, month-end closing, and reporting

• Transformation and digitalization of finance functions, e.g., process optimization, closing excellence, internal controls advisory, and leveraging technology solutions

• Enterprise performance management, e.g., analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting

• ERP-enabled finance transformations and finance systems implementation, e.g., outlining the ERP-strategy, defining business requirements and ensuring consistent data migration

• Finance strategy and operating model, e.g., designing service delivery models, outlining roles and responsibilities and conducting assessments

• M&A readiness and finance post-merger integration

• Global business services transformations, e.g., assessing, developing and implementing shared service functions and aligning service delivery with corporate strategy

• Internal business development and leadership support, e.g., assisting on client proposals, facilitating events and developing material to strengthen our market offerings.

Onboarding and learning

When joining us, you will participate in our onboarding programme designed with the purpose of giving you the best foundation for kickstarting your career in Deloitte. During your first two weeks, you and your peers will attend our Finance Transformation Nordic Bootcamp and our Consultant Academy, where the content is tailored to match your competencies as recent graduates. The Finance Transformation Bootcamp helps you in building your finance craftmanship and toolbox, while the Consultant Academy prepares you for your consulting role in Deloitte Technology & Transformation. Also heavily focused on social activities and team-building, the onboarding programme provides a smooth transition from university as it offers a unique opportunity to connect and build strong relations with your fellow new joiners from day one.

At Deloitte, we believe in life-long learning, and we are committed to investing in your individual development, both professionally and personally, throughout your career. You will experience this with our Finance Consultancy Programme, which is a highly structured learning programme, aimed at equipping you with the appropriate skillset and the right level of competencies needed to succeed in your role.

Leadership and culture

To support your learning, you will also be assigned a People Leader as your closest leader and go-to sparring partner. Your People Leader will help you set the overall direction of your journey in Deloitte and provide guidance across projects to make sure that your individual aspirations and professional development goals are met. Every career path is unique, and together with your People Leader you get the chance to shape your own.

We believe in leadership at all levels, and we have committed ourselves to creating and maintaining an inclusive and psychologically safe culture, where you are encouraged and empowered to take responsibility while leading both yourself and others. We combine this with a substantial focus on continuously staying relevant and being a meaningful social community to our people. We are a people’s business, and therefore we strongly believe that this is an essential prerequisite for making an impact that truly matters – for ourselves and for our clients**.

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you, who are passionate about consulting and the CFO-area and who are willing to go the extra mile to deliver sustainable impact that truly matters to our clients. You show an eagerness to make a difference for both clients and colleagues and you are able to see the opportunities and potential in all types of assignments. As our business can be highly changeable, it is important that you are curious by nature, and that you face challenges with an open-minded and solution-oriented approach.

In addition to this, you:

• Have completed a master’s degree within the fields of finance, economics, business, accounting, social sciences, IT, or similar areas in the summer of 2027 or before

• Have achieved academic results from your bachelor’s and master’s degree that you are proud of

• Demonstrate a flair for both oral and written communication and are fluent in English

• Have a legal working permit in Denmark

Although relevant job experience might be an advantage, this is not a requirement.

Additional Information

Want to know more?

Click the "I'm interested"-button above and upload your CV and grade transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degree if you are interested and ready to join our team**. Instead of an application letter, we would like you to answer the questions you will be presented with on the next pages** (please only consider the required (*) fields). As we process applications and arrange interviews on an ongoing basis, we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Application deadline: Hiring on an ongoing basis.

Please do not hesitate to contact Giulio Marano (gimarano@deloitte.dk / +45 30 93 64 11) or Maria Banke (mbanke@deloitte.dk / +45 20 97 64 15) if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Turn insights into acquisition experiments that scale

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Clinical Sciences, you'll help turn Hemab's science into well-designed clinical studies and clear evidence about how our treatments perform in patients. You'll take scientific ownership across protocol development, study execution and data interpretation, working closely with Medical Directors and colleagues across clinical development, regulatory and other functions.

What you'll do

• Lead the clinical science contribution to study strategy, design and execution, keeping the scientific questions and patient needs at the centre of decisions.

• Drive protocol development with the Medical Director, including amendments as emerging data or study needs require.

• Own the scientific review of clinical study data, identify discrepancies and trends, and turn emerging safety and efficacy data into clear questions and actions for the team.

• Shape study documents and plans, including informed consent forms, eCRFs, medical monitoring plans and data review plans.

• Guide sites and vendors on protocol requirements, eligibility criteria and participant management so studies are executed consistently and to the intended design.

• Partner across clinical development to analyse and interpret study results and build a clear understanding of what the data mean.

• Translate study findings for internal and external audiences alongside the Medical Director.

• Develop clinical content for regulatory documents, including investigator brochures, annual safety reports, clinical study reports and registration submissions.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Substantial clinical science or clinical research experience in drug development, with direct responsibility for clinical studies.

• Experience developing clinical protocols and interpreting safety and efficacy data from interventional studies.

• A strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical study design and drug development in a regulated environment.

• The scientific judgement to interpret clinical information, literature and changing treatment approaches and apply it to study and development decisions.

• Experience working effectively with investigators, vendors and cross-functional clinical, medical and regulatory colleagues.

Nice to have

• Experience in haematology, rare disease or bleeding disorders.

• Experience contributing to development programmes through later-stage studies and registration.

• An advanced scientific or clinical degree.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant - Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a collaborative, cross functional environment where you can support strategic projects and contribute to meaningful solutions that improve the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs? Then this Student Assistant position in Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio could be the perfect opportunity to kick-start your career.

Join Us: Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio

At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio team. Our team manages and owns the full product lifecycle in Continence Care, from early idea generation and innovation through global market launch to product discontinuation. Our work spans short-, mid-, and long-term innovation initiatives, as well as lifecycle management of existing solutions.

We are commercially driven, with our users at the heart of everything we do. Every day, we work to make bladder management easier for our users, believing that strong commercial decisions and deep user understanding go hand in hand.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approximately 15–20 hours per week and support the team across a variety of activities. You will gain exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating closely with experienced colleagues across functions, supporting portfolio and pipeline initiatives, and contributing to projects that help shape the future of Continence Care.

The role offers:

•  Valuable insight into the product lifecycle and commercial decision-making

•  Cross-functional collaboration in a global healthcare company

•  A unique opportunity to build deep business understanding

•  A strong platform to advance your career within Coloplast

Your key focus will be to support the team's activities and contribute to projects that drive innovation and portfolio development in Continence Care. Tasks will vary but are likely to include:

•  Supporting the development of competitive product positioning and claims for marketing and sales activities

•  Collecting and analysing customer feedback and market insights

•  Supporting commercial forecasting activities across innovation projects

•  Assisting with day-to-day team activities, including maintaining SharePoint content, managing product samples, and supporting workshops

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

We imagine that you:

•  Are currently studying a bachelor's or master’s degree within business, marketing, innovation or a related field

•  Have strong organisational skills and enjoy coordinating tasks across different projects

•  Possess strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data, including Excel

•  Take ownership of your work and follow through on your commitments

•  Are fluent in English, Danish is not required

•  Possibly have some first working experience

On top of that you are curious and eager to learn, always looking to develop new skills and take on new challenges. You enjoy working in an international environment, collaborating with colleagues across functions, and contributing ideas that help move projects forward.

Interested?

For more information, contact Christina Sommer, Senior Product Manager Pipeline & Portfolio, at dkcsom@coloplast.com.

We will review candidates on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity

Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

To thrive in this role, you’ll likely bring:

• Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner or in a similar role, with responsibility for business-critical services or platforms.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra-related dependencies.

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical, scalable IT solutions.

About the role and the team

You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. Your work will help ensure employees have effective tools for communication, meetings, document collaboration, knowledge sharing and everyday productivity.

What you’ll be working on

• Own the service lifecycle across the collaboration and productivity portfolio, ensuring clear governance, documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

• Define and monitor service-level objectives, availability and user experience; follow up on incidents and recurring problems and make improvements.

• Manage licensing, renewals, budget follow-up, cost control and supplier performance.

• Work with business and technical stakeholders to govern access, information sharing, external collaboration, retention and service lifecycles.

• Manage cross-functional change and adoption initiatives, identifying practical opportunities for automation, AI, standardization and better ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, connecting employee needs with operational, technical, security and strategic priorities.

Who we are looking for

You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to service management, and you’re comfortable moving between strategic development and day-to-day operational priorities. You build effective working relationships across business and technical teams, and can assess dependencies, risks and competing needs to move work forward. You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

Practical information

• The role is based in Denmark.

• GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least 3 days per week in the office.

• GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.

In this role, you’ll have the scope to shape a broad, business-critical portfolio and help make everyday collaboration more secure, reliable and effective for employees.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

About the company

GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.

We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

Contributing to a better tomorrowBuilding the foundation of a better tomorrow – a digitized and sustainable society.

ExpansiveFast-paced company with high growth ambitions, backed by leading investment company EQT.

InternationalWork and develop in an international environment.

DevelopingWork with and learn from diverse and experienced industry leading professionals.

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

🚚 Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

🚛 Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

• 
Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

• 
Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

• 
Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

• 
Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

🧰 Vi forventer, at du:

• 
Har kørekort C og/eller CE

• 
Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

• 
Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

• 
Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

• 
Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

• 
Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

• 
En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• 
Velholdte lastbiler

• 
Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

• 
Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer

📩 Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:
job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

🚚 About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

🚛 About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Driving a truck on day distribution routes

• 
Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

• 
Sorting and handling freight during loading

• 
Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

🧰 We Expect You To:

• 
Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

• 
Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

• 
Be reliable, independent, and responsible

• 
Be physically fit and able to handle freight

•

Job Description

As Accounting Manager at Netcompany Denmark and Netcompany Banking Services, you are responsible for accounting topics such as annual reports, IFRS, tax, VAT and the audit process. You report to the Head of Finance for Denmark and Banking Services and support in leading and developing the team.

Netcompany DK and NBS are part of the wider Netcompany Group. While Group Finance defines the finance framework, standards, and processes, you are responsible for translating these into the local context and supporting the Danish business in making informed financial and strategic decisions.

You will work closely with the local Finance leadership team, Group Finance and your fellow Accounting managers across the Netcompany Group. We are ambitious in how we develop our Finance organisation and actively embrace new technology and ways of working.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Take end-to-end responsibility for financial reporting, annual accounts, IFRS, tax and VAT, management reporting, commercial finance and KPI forecasting.

• Act as a trusted team member in Denmark and Banking Services Finance leadership team, supporting both day-to-day decision making and the achievement of long-term ambitions.

• Translate Group Finance frameworks, standards and ambitions into the local Danish context, and make sure they are implemented well across the organisation.

• Help continue the process of creating a culture focused on quality, ownership, collaboration and continuous development.

• Support the continued development and adoption of AI-enabled tools and ways of working across Finance, actively contributing to our ambition to build a more digital, automated and insight-driven finance function.

About you:

• You hold a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a comparable field.

• 3–6 years of experience in accounting, audit or a similar field.

• Proven experience working with IFRS standards and financial compliance and reporting requirements.

• Strong analytical and business-related problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complicated financial tasks.

• Structured and reliable approach to delivering high-quality results with attention to detail and within deadlines.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a real interest in developing people as well as delivering results yourself.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Provide the Danish and Banking Services with clear and reliable insights that support both short- and long-term decision making.

• Ensure accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting across the Danish and Banking Services organization.

• Successfully translate Group Finance Accounting standards and ambitions into effective local processes and ways of working.

• Identify opportunities to improve financial performance, processes and reporting, and turn these into tangible results.

• Successfully contribute to the transition towards our new Finance system landscape, including our bespoke AI-driven Finance application.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritize an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant with experience in operations and supply chain, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Do you bring a strong business background in supply chain and experience from internal or external consulting? Are you curious about working with technology, data and digital solutions? And are you motivated by helping organisations solve complex problems and create lasting, meaningful results? Then this could be a wonderful opportunity for you.

About Valcon

Valcon is a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation. With offices in the Netherlands, Denmark, the UK, Sweden, Croatia and Serbia, we bring consulting, technology and data together to help organisations turn ambition into measurable results. We welcome colleagues with different backgrounds, perspectives and ways of working who are motivated to create value together.

In this role, you will…

• Help clients improve their supply chains by solving complex challenges across planning, procurement, and operations

• Lead or contribute to transformation initiatives from analysis and solution design through implementation, creating measurable business value along the way

• Build strong relationships with clients and colleagues, bringing people together around practical solutions that improve performance, decision-making, and long-term resilience

• Use data, insights, and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities and help organizations create more efficient and future-ready supply chains

We’re looking for someone who…

• Has experience within Supply Chain, Operations, Management Consulting, or another transformation-focused role

• Brings expertise from areas such as Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Logistics/Distribution, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Operational Excellence

• Enjoys turning complexity into clarity and can balance analytical thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach

• Can independently lead, manage and effectively drive complex transformation programs/projects

• Has experience with data, digital solutions, or technology-enabled transformation, and is curious about how innovation can create business value

• Is a strong relationship builder who can engage stakeholders across different organizational levels and drive change through collaboration

• Holds a relevant master’s degree

What we can offer

At Valcon, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and supported. Our career model provides clear roles and expectations, supported by a fair and transparent process for all. You will join an international work environment with an informal culture and a flat hierarchy that encourages both personal and professional growth. Here, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented colleagues across business areas and levels.

We also offer enhanced benefits and support across different life stages, including parental and adoption leave, health and wellbeing initiatives, and resources for navigating significant life transitions. Our culture is shaped by our core values — Integrity, Together, Joy, Curious and Can Do — which guide how we work and grow together. We regularly come together for social events and activities such as yoga, wine tasting, knitting nights, padel tennis, Friday bars and seasonal parties. Our hub, “The Hive,” is a welcoming office in the heart of Copenhagen at Meldahlsgade 5, where homemade breakfast and lunch are served every day.

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Head of Center of Excellence for Project Management
jobs.description:
At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox/mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, working every day to protect people’s health and quality of life and protect our tomorrow.

We are looking for an experienced leader for the Head of Center of Excellence (project management) role in our Strategy Execution department who combines strategic thinking, strong change management capabilities, and a genuine passion for building organizational capability. In this role, you will not only define how projects are governed and delivered but also drive the adoption of new ways of working across a global organization.

**About The Role

**This is a broad and hands-on role spanning project leadership and organizational capability building within project excellence. A key aspect of the role is driving organizational change by ensuring that project management frameworks, tools, and processes are successfully adopted, understood, and embedded across the business. In this dual role, you will balance being Head of Center of Excellence while managing high-impact cross-functional projects yourself. Just as importantly, you will turn standards into practice by designing and delivering training, facilitating sessions, coaching colleagues, and creating engagement across the organization.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and corporate functions. The portfolio may include merger and acquisition activities, development projects, vaccine launches, technology implementations, and other enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Success requires someone who enjoys moving between strategic planning, practical implementation, and visible facilitation in front of an audience.

The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will join a team of +20 Project Managers, Program Leads, and Student Assistants and report to the VP of Strategy Execution Office.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously strengthen project management standards, governance, tools, templates, and ways of working across the organization

• Lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects, including initiatives connected to M&A, product development, vaccine launches, and enterprise transformation

• Drive adoption of project management methodologies and support organizational change through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and coaching

• Develop project management capability through structured training, facilitation, coaching, and hands-on knowledge sharing across different functions and seniority levels

• Serve as a visible ambassador for project excellence, translating methodology into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences

• Partner with senior stakeholders to create alignment, transparency, sound decision-making, and clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle

• Drive disciplined planning, risk management, resource coordination, and execution, supported by strong use of project and portfolio management tools

**What You Bring

**You bring extensive experience leading complex projects within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated healthcare environment. You also bring change management expertise combined with hands-on delivery experience. Besides this, we are looking for someone with the following background;

• A genuine interest in the full scope of project management excellence, from strategic framework design and governance to practical implementation and organizational training

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence and energy to stand in front of an audience, engage participants, and make complex methods practical and relevant

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, create buy-in, and lead through complex global and cross-functional environments

• Strong knowledge of PMI-based project management practices. PMI/PMP certification is an advantage - other relevant certifications are also valued

• Experience with merger and acquisition projects

• A relevant master’s degree within life sciences, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field

• Advanced expertise in Smartsheet combined with experience with Microsoft Project is an advantage

**Why join us?

**This role gives you the opportunity to influence both how strategic projects are delivered and how project management capability is built across Bavarian Nordic. You will combine high-impact project leadership with the chance to shape standards, develop colleagues, and create a lasting project excellence culture in a purpose-driven global vaccine organization.

If you are motivated by strategy and execution, enjoy building practical solutions, and feel energized by training and engaging others, we would love to hear from you.

**Caught your interest?

**Apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We do not offer any relocation packages for this role. Please note that employment is contingent on residing and working in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

Would you like to take the lead in turning business opportunities into digital solutions that create measurable commercial impact?

As Digital Business Transformation Lead, you will help execute Hartmann’s European commercial strategy by identifying, shaping and delivering digital initiatives that improve customer experience and commercial efficiency. Reporting to the Commercial Excellence Director, Europe, you will work across markets and functions to turn business needs into practical solutions with measurable impact.

You will own the business side of agreed initiatives from discovery and concept development through implementation, adoption and benefits realisation. Group IT and technology partners will own architecture, cybersecurity and technical solution design.

Key responsibilities

• Identify and evaluate digital opportunities with customers and stakeholders across Hartmann’s European commercial organisation.

• Translate needs into customer journeys, future-state processes, concepts, prototypes and business requirements.

• Build business cases and support prioritisation of the European commercial digital portfolio.

• Lead the business side of agreed initiatives from discovery through implementation and adoption.

• Establish milestones, governance, risks, responsibilities and benefits tracking.

• Partner with Group IT and external providers while keeping customer needs and business outcomes central.

• Drive adoption through stakeholder engagement, communication, training and performance measurement.

Your experience and approach

You bring approximately 5–8 years of relevant experience in digital business transformation, product ownership, consulting or complex cross-functional delivery.

We expect you to have:

• Strong commercial and process understanding

• Experience taking unclear opportunities from discovery to implementation and adoption

• Ability to create structure, influence senior stakeholders and secure cross-functional commitment

• Working knowledge of digital platforms, data, automation and AI

• Strong English and sufficient Danish for informal workplace communication

Experience from manufacturing or an international B2B environment is valuable, but your ability to understand customers and turn business needs into practical improvements matters most.

You are curious, pragmatic and proactive. You create direction in ambiguous situations, test ideas quickly and remain hands-on until solutions are adopted and create value.

Hartmann offers

You will join an international company with more than 100 years of history and a strong position in the global food packaging industry.

The role offers:

• Ownership of visible European digital initiatives.

• Direct collaboration with customers, commercial leadership and Group IT.

• Freedom to test practical applications of digital solutions, automation and AI.

• An international role combining strategy, discovery and hands-on execution.

You will be responsible for translating Hartmann Europe’s commercial digital priorities into adopted solutions and measurable business improvements—not for defining enterprise technology strategy or owning technical architecture.

Location

The position is based at Hartmann’s headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark, with a flexible hybrid working arrangement. Expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year, primarily within Europe.

Contact and application

Hartmann is assisted in this recruitment process by European Search Company.

For more information, please contact Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638 or Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548.

Please submit your application using the apply button below. We review applications as they arrive and encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

About Hartmann Packaging

Founded in 1917, Hartmann is headquartered in Lyngby, Denmark. Hartmann is the world’s leading specialist in moulded fibre egg packaging and a trusted partner in the global food supply chain.

With more than 100 years of experience, we combine deep technology and manufacturing expertise with a strong global presence to design, produce, and deliver innovative moulded fibre products. In doing so, we provide sustainable packaging that helps feed the world – one carton at a time.

Hartmann employs approximately 2,800 employees across Europe, North America, South America, and APAC. Hartmann is part of the THORNICO Group
